rationale: The hypothesis posits that the phenotypic dichotomy between congenital structural malformations (congenital heart disease/heterotaxy) and isolated late-onset thoracic aortopathy in SMAD2 mutation carriers is governed by variant escape from nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD). However, available molecular and clinical data contradict this mechanism. In Granadillo et al. (2018), probands presenting with complex congenital heart disease and syndromic malformations harbored missense variants (e.g., Patient 2 with a de novo missense variant) as well as splice and truncating variants, demonstrating that congenital malformations are not restricted to or driven by premature termination codons that escape NMD. Additionally, published series of LDS6 and SMAD2 aortopathy demonstrate that both loss-of-function truncating variants subject to canonical NMD and missense mutations in both the MH1 and MH2 domains can lead to either phenotype, with extensive phenotypic overlap and variable expressivity rather than an NMD-escape dichotomous switch.

evidence.text: Granadillo et al. identified two distinct phenotypic presentations of pathogenic SMAD2 variants (complex CHD with or without laterality defects versus late-onset vascular aneurysms). Complex CHD and syndromic anomalies occurred in patients with a de novo missense variant (Patient 2) as well as truncating and splice variants, directly refuting the claim that early congenital malformations are exclusively governed by truncating variants escaping NMD.

conflicts: The hypothesis predicts that severe congenital structural malformations/heterotaxy are caused exclusively by truncating variants escaping NMD, but Granadillo et al. (2018) documented complex CHD with neurodevelopmental abnormalities caused by a de novo missense variant in SMAD2.

Patients with truncating variants predicted to undergo classical nonsense-mediated decay also exhibit early congenital heart defects such as VSDs, demonstrating that canonical loss of function/haploinsufficiency is sufficient to cause congenital heart anomalies without requiring NMD escape.

new_directions.question_text: Does transcriptomic quantification of SMAD2 mRNA from patient-derived fibroblasts confirm whether specific truncating variants trigger complete NMD versus stable truncated protein production?
new_directions.rationale: Directly testing allele-specific expression and NMD degradation of truncating variants in both aortopathy-predominant and CHD-predominant carriers will establish whether truncated proteins are translated or fully degraded.

new_directions.question_text: Do SMAD2 missense variants identified in heterotaxy/CHD patients exert distinct dominant-negative effects on left-right patterning effectors (such as NODAL/LEFTY signaling) compared to isolated aortopathy variants?
new_directions.rationale: Investigating functional impairment of SMAD2-SMAD4 transcriptional complex assembly in embryonic laterality assays can clarify whether tissue-specific signaling thresholds rather than NMD escape explain the phenotypic divergence.
